description: This file defines an error handling function for the ADODB database abstraction library in PHP. It sets up a custom error handler that formats error messages related to database operations and logs or triggers errors accordingly.

methods.name: ADODB_Error_Handler
methods.description: Handles database errors, formats error messages based on the function called (EXECUTE, PCONNECT, CONNECT, etc.), logs the error according to configured logging type, and triggers a PHP error.
